title: 第七章离城第八章天机第九章 山谷
content_zh:
三天，一晃而过。
这三天里，方圆没有离开过院子一步。
他白天在老槐树下盘膝打坐，吸收天地灵气，巩固凝气境一重的修为。夜里则修炼《玄帝不灭经》的第二层——这门帝级功法共分九层，淬体境修炼的是第一层“淬体篇”，主要打磨血肉骨骼；进入凝气境后，便可以修炼第二层“凝气篇”，开始淬炼灵气的纯度与密度。
普通人修炼，灵气从天地间汲取，能炼化三分算天赋异禀。而方圆修炼帝级功法，灵气入体后经过九重淬炼，杂质尽去，留下的每一丝都是最精纯的本源之力。
这三天里，他的修为没有突破到凝气二重，但灵气的质量却有了质的飞跃。
如果说普通凝气境武者的灵气是铁，那他的灵气就是百炼精钢。
同样的力量，威力相差十倍。
第三天的清晨，阳光刚刚越过院墙，洒在老槐树的叶片上，泛着金色的光。
方圆收功起身，活动了一下筋骨，骨骼发出噼里啪啦的脆响。
“成了？”王紫璇从厨房端着一碗热粥走出来，身上系着围裙，头发随意扎成一个马尾，脸上还沾了一点面粉。
方圆看着她这副模样，愣了一瞬。
堂堂王家大小姐，青州第一美人，居然在给他做早饭？
“看什么看？”王紫璇注意到他的目光，脸微微一红，“本小姐好心给你做饭，你还挑三拣四？”
“我没挑。”
“那你喝粥。”
方圆接过粥碗，低头喝了一口。
味道竟然还不错。
“你什么时候学会做饭的？”方圆问。
王紫璇解下围裙，在他对面坐下，托着腮帮子看他喝粥：“今天早上刚学的。厨房张妈教了我半个时辰，我天资聪颖，一学就会。”
方圆：“……所以你拿我当实验品？”

“实验什么？放心，没毒。”王紫璇笑嘻嘻地说，“要毒死你我也不会费这么大劲，昨晚趁你修炼一刀捅了不就完了。”
方圆无语，把粥喝完，将碗放在石桌上。
“东西都准备好了？”
王紫璇点头，从屋里拿出一个包袱，在石桌上打开。
包袱里东西不少：一张详细的地图（比之前那张羊皮纸详细得多，是王紫璇花了三天时间从各方搜集来的）、几瓶疗伤丹药、一袋干粮、两壶清水、一把备用的短剑、几块灵石，还有一个巴掌大的罗盘。
“这是什么？”方圆拿起那个罗盘。罗盘上的指针不是指向南北，而是指向一个固定的方向——西北。
“定星盘。”王紫璇说，“我爹留下的遗物之一。指针永远指向那座山的方向，不管你在哪里，只要拿出定星盘，就能找到路。”
方圆把玩了一下定星盘，指针纹丝不动，坚定地指向西北方。
“准备齐全。”方圆将东西一一放回包袱，“什么时候出发？”
“今天傍晚。”王紫璇说，“青州城每天傍晚开西城门运送货物，人多眼杂，混出去不容易被盯上。方家主已经安排好了，我们从西门出，方家暗卫会在后面跟着。”
方圆点头，没有异议。
王紫璇又拿出一套黑色的劲装，递给方圆：“换上这个，方便行动。你那一身白衣服太显眼了，走在路上方圆十里都能看见。”
方圆接过衣服，回屋换上。
黑色的劲装贴合身形，袖口和裤腿都用束带扎紧，行动方便，确实验证了王紫璇的细心。
他推门出来，王紫璇上下打量了一番，满意地点头：“不错，比我预想的顺眼。”
“你也换了？”方圆注意到王紫璇今天穿的也不是那身标志性的红裙，而是一身深蓝色的紧身衣，长发束成高马尾，整个人看起来英姿飒爽，少了几分娇俏，多了几分干练。
“出门在外，低调最重要。”王紫璇将包袱背在肩上，“走吧，时间还早，先去见见方家主，他还有话要交代。”
两人穿过方家内院，走向正堂。
一路上遇到的方家族人，看到方圆都纷纷让路，眼神中带着复杂的情绪——敬畏者有之，嫉妒者有之，好奇者亦有之。
三天前族比上一拳轰飞方铭、一拳捏碎方烈手掌的战绩，已经传遍了整个方家。

曾经那个被所有人踩在脚下的废物，如今已经站到了所有人的头顶。
没有人再敢叫他废物。
content_en:
Three days passed by in a flash.
In the past three days, Fangyuan has not left the yard.
During the day, he sat cross-legged and meditated under the old locust tree, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and consolidating his cultivation in the first level of Qi Condensation Realm. At night, he practiced the second level of the "Xuan Emperor Immortality Sutra" - this emperor-level technique is divided into nine levels. The first level "Body Tempering Chapter" practiced in the Body Tempering Realm is mainly polishing flesh and blood and bones; after entering the Qi Condensation Realm, you can practice the second level "Qi Condensation Chapter" to start tempering the purity and density of spiritual energy.
Ordinary people practice and draw spiritual energy from heaven and earth. They are gifted with the ability to refine three-point calculations. As for Fangyuan's practice of Emperor-level skills, after the spiritual energy enters the body, it undergoes nine levels of tempering, and all impurities are removed, leaving every trace of the purest source power behind.
In the past three days, his cultivation has not broken through to the second level of Qi Condensation, but the quality of his spiritual energy has made a qualitative leap.
If the aura of an ordinary Qi Condensing Realm warrior is iron, then his aura is that of hundred-refined steel.
The same power, but the power is ten times different.
In the early morning of the third day, the sun had just crossed the courtyard wall and shone on the leaves of the old locust tree, glowing with golden light.
Fangyuan stood up and moved his muscles, making a crackling sound.
"Done?" Wang Zixuan came out of the kitchen carrying a bowl of hot porridge, wearing an apron, her hair tied into a ponytail, and a little flour on her face.
Fangyuan looked at her appearance and was stunned for a moment.
The dignified eldest lady of the Wang family, the most beautiful woman in Qingzhou, is actually making breakfast for him?
"What are you looking at?" Wang Zixuan noticed his gaze and blushed slightly, "I am kind enough to cook for you, but you are still picky?"
"I didn't pick."
"Then you drink porridge."
Fangyuan took the porridge bowl, lowered his head and took a sip.
The taste turned out to be quite good.
"When did you learn to cook?" Fang Yuan asked.
Wang Zixuan took off her apron and sat down opposite him. She held her cheek and watched him eating porridge: "I just learned it this morning. Mom Zhang in the kitchen taught me for half an hour. I am very talented and can learn it as soon as I learn it."
Fangyuan: "...So you use me as a test subject?"
"What are you experimenting on? Don't worry, it's not poisonous." Wang Zixuan said with a smile, "I won't go to such great lengths to poison you. I just stabbed you while you were practicing last night and it's over."
Fangyuan was speechless, finished the porridge and placed the bowl on the stone table.
"Is everything ready?"
Wang Zixuan nodded, took out a bundle from the room, and opened it on the stone table.
There were a lot of things in the baggage: a detailed map (much more detailed than the previous parchment, which Wang Zixuan spent three days collecting from all sides), several bottles of healing elixirs, a bag of dry food, two jugs of water, a spare dagger, a few spiritual stones, and a palm-sized compass.
"What is this?" Fangyuan picked up the compass. The needle on the compass points not to north or south, but to a fixed direction - northwest.
"The astrolabe." Wang Zixuan said, "One of the relics left by my father. The pointer will always point in the direction of the mountain. No matter where you are, you can find the way as long as you take out the astrolabe."
Fangyuan played with the set astrolabe, and the pointer did not move at all, pointing firmly to the northwest.
"Everything is ready." Fangyuan put the things back into the bag one by one, "When will we set off?"
"This evening." Wang Zixuan said, "Qingzhou City opens the west gate every evening to transport goods. There are many people and it is difficult to get caught if you sneak out. The head of the Fang family has made arrangements. We will go out through the west gate, and the Fang family's secret guards will follow us."
Fang Yuan nodded without any objection.
Wang Zixuan took out another black outfit and handed it to Fangyuan: "Put on this one to make it easier to move around. Your white clothes are so conspicuous that they can be seen from ten miles away when walking on the road."
Fangyuan took the clothes and went back to the house to change them.
The black outfit fits the body shape, and the cuffs and trouser legs are tied tightly with drawstrings, making it easy to move. It really proves Wang Zixuan's attentiveness.
He pushed the door open and came out. Wang Zixuan looked up and down and was satisfied.Nodding: "Not bad, more pleasing to the eye than I expected."
"Have you changed too?" Fang Yuan noticed that Wang Zixuan was not wearing the iconic red dress today, but a dark blue tights. Her long hair was tied into a high ponytail. She looked dashing, less delicate and more capable.
"Being low-key is the most important thing when you are out." Wang Zixuan put the bag on her shoulders, "Let's go, it's still early, let's go see the head of the Fang family first, he has something to explain."
The two of them walked through the inner courtyard of the Fang family and walked towards the main hall.
The Fang family members they met along the way gave way one after another when they saw Fang Yuan, with complex emotions in their eyes - some were in awe, some were jealous, and some were curious.
Three days ago, the clan's record of knocking Fang Ming away with one punch and crushing Fang Lie's hand with one punch had spread throughout the entire Fang family.
The trash that was once trampled under everyone's feet has now stood above everyone's heads.
No one dares to call him trash anymore.
